verdict.rationale: cubic's AI wiki indexes the codebase into searchable wikis with source links and architecture diagrams. It exports them as markdown into the repo and keeps them current through a rolling PR, which gives the team a shared, repo-derived knowledge base. Cross-repo linking and an org-level cubic-config repo add some multi-repo shared context. However, nothing shows building a workspace from external docs, and the org config only covers review settings, not team knowledge. Missing for 10: ingesting non-code docs into a shared workspace, an explicit team workspace or knowledge-hub construct, independent corroboration of the wiki.
